name: Simon the Zealot
title: The Zealous One
summary: Simon the Zealot, also called Simon Canaanite, was one of Jesus' twelve apostles. The nickname 'the Zealot' or 'the zealous one' may indicate that he belonged to the Zealots—a Jewish resistance movement against the Romans—before becoming a disciple. As an apostle, he represents Jesus' ability to unite people from diverse backgrounds.

keyEvents.title: Chosen as an Apostle
keyEvents.description: Simon the Zealot was chosen as one of Jesus' twelve apostles and is mentioned in the lists of apostles in all four Gospels.

keyEvents.title: Called Canaanite
keyEvents.description: Matthew and Mark call him Simon Canaanite, which comes from the Aramaic word for 'zealous'—the same meaning as Zealot.

keyEvents.title: Among the Twelve
keyEvents.description: Simon is mentioned among the twelve whom Jesus called and gave authority to preach and heal.

keyEvents.title: In the Upper Room
keyEvents.description: After the ascension, Simon Zelotes was among the apostles who gathered in prayer in the upper room in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Sent Out
keyEvents.description: Simon was one of the twelve whom Jesus sent out to proclaim that the kingdom of God had come near.
